documents.title: Privacy Policy
documents.summary: How Mobile Station Electronics Commerce collects, encrypts, uses, and safeguards your order details, GSTIN, device IMEI records, and delivery data under India DPDP Act 2023.
documents.content_markdown:
## 1. Who We Are & Scope

Mobile Station Electronics Commerce (**Mobile Station**) operates authorized flagship retail & fulfillment centers at **Motijheel (842001)** and **Club Road (842002), Muzaffarpur, Bihar** alongside our online storefront across India. This Privacy Policy explains how personal data is processed in alignment with the **Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023** and Indian e-commerce rules.

## 2. Information We Collect

- **Order & Fulfillment Details**: Full name, delivery street address, 6-digit Indian PIN code, mobile number, and alternate contact reference.
- **Tax & Warranty Compliance**: Serial / IMEI identifiers printed on GST tax invoices, and optional 15-character **B2B GSTIN & Registered Business Name** when GST Input Tax Credit is requested.
- **Payment Verification**: Transaction status and tokenized payment references from **Razorpay** (we never store full card numbers, CVVs, or UPI PINs on Mobile Station servers).
- **On-Device Storefront Preferences**: Local browsing recency, cart items, and saved delivery PIN stored locally in your browser storage to improve pickup and compatibility recommendations.

## 3. Strict Infrastructure & Third-Party Boundaries

| Layer | Purpose | Storage Boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PostgreSQL Database | Orders, GST tax splits, IMEI/serial warranty ledgers | Encrypted server-side persistence |
| S3 / R2 Private Bucket | Generated GST Tax Invoice PDFs & unboxing proof | Short-lived signed URLs only (`<= 15 mins`) |
| Shiprocket Courier API | Airway bill & Open-Box Delivery doorstep OTP verification | Shared strictly for shipment fulfillment |
| Razorpay Checkout | UPI, RuPay, Card & No-Cost EMI authorization | PCI-DSS compliant payment gateway |

We **never sell, rent, or trade** customer phone numbers or email addresses to third-party telemarketers or data brokers.

## 4. Data Retention & Your Rights

- Statutory tax invoices and IMEI warranty logs are retained as mandated under **Indian GST law** (typically 6–8 financial years).
- You may request correction of address/contact details or deletion of non-statutory marketing profile records at any time.

## 5. Grievance Officer & Privacy Support

> For privacy inquiries, data correction requests, or grievance redressal, contact **support@mobilestation.in** or visit our Motijheel Flagship Hub desk in Muzaffarpur (`842001`), Monday to Saturday (10:30 AM – 7:30 PM).

documents.title: Terms & Conditions
documents.summary: Governing terms for purchasing factory-sealed smartphones, laptops, audio gear, GST billing, Open-Box verification, and Pan-India shipping from Mobile Station.
documents.content_markdown:
## 1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing **Mobile Station** or placing an order online or at our Muzaffarpur hubs (`842001` / `842002`), you agree to these Terms & Conditions. All hardware is intended strictly for lawful end-user or registered Indian enterprise procurement.

## 2. Pricing, INR Currency & GST Inclusivity

- All listed prices are in **Indian Rupees (INR)** and inclusive of applicable **GST** (default **18% GST** across electronics HSN classifications unless explicitly noted otherwise).
- Promotional coupon codes apply strictly to eligible categories or SKUs as stated in coupon scope terms.
- B2B GSTIN details entered prior to dispatch cannot be retro-amended after GST GSTR-1 filing.

## 3. Product Authenticity & Sealed Packaging

1. Every unit sold is genuine, Indian-authorized retail inventory.
2. Factory seals remain intact until either doorstep **Open-Box Delivery** verification in front of the courier or in-store unboxing inspection at Motijheel / Club Road.
3. Once an active SIM card is inserted or OEM software activation is completed on an undisputed device, post-activation hardware claims follow official OEM warranty procedures.

## 4. Order Cancellation & Jurisdiction

- Orders may be cancelled prior to AWB handoff without penalty.
- High-value flagged transactions may require secondary OTP verification to prevent unauthorized orders.
- Disputes are subject to competent jurisdiction in **Muzaffarpur, Bihar, India**.

documents.title: 100% Official Brand Authorized Warranty
documents.summary: Every smartphone, tablet, laptop, monitor, audio gear, and accessory sold by Mobile Station is a factory-sealed Indian retail unit covered directly by official brand service networks across India.
documents.content_markdown:
## Standard Authorized Brand Coverage

Every electronic device sold at Mobile Station carries valid **Official Brand Warranty** redeemable at authorized service centers Pan-India.

- **Zero Grey-Market Units**: Only GST-paid Indian retail units with valid OEM serial/IMEI registration.
- **Serialized Tax Invoice**: Includes exact **HSN code** and device **IMEI / Serial Number** required for Apple, Samsung, OnePlus, Sony, Vivo, Oppo, Xiaomi, Nothing, Google, Lenovo, HP, ASUS, and SanDisk service claims.
- **7-Day Hub Replacement Support**: Immediate replacement assistance at our Muzaffarpur Hub in the rare case of certified Dead-on-Arrival (DOA) hardware defects reported within 7 days.

### Cross-Link Resources

- Review [Insured Open-Box Delivery](/policies/open-box-delivery)
- Read [18% GST Tax Invoice Rules](/policies/gst-invoicing)

documents.title: Insured Open-Box Delivery Policy
documents.summary: High-value smartphones, tablets, and laptops (orders ₹25,000+) undergo an assisted doorstep unboxing check before OTP handover so you never assume transit risk.
documents.content_markdown:
## Doorstep Unboxing Protocol

For eligible smartphones, laptops, and flagship tablets (`₹25,000+`), your shipment arrives under **Insured Open-Box Delivery (OBD)** protection:

1. **Inspect Outer Tamper Seal**: Confirm carton security tape and retail box factory seal with the delivery executive.
2. **Verify Physical Condition & IMEI**: Inspect the display, camera glass, chassis, and confirm the box IMEI / Serial number matches your invoice.
3. **Confirm Inbox Accessories**: Verify included cables, charging adapters (where bundled by OEM), or S Pen / accessories.
4. **Share OTP Only After Verification**: Once OTP is shared and signed, physical transit damage cannot be claimed post-handoff.

> Never share your Open-Box Delivery OTP over phone call before inspecting the opened device in person.

documents.title: 18% GST Tax Invoice & B2B Input Tax Credit
documents.summary: All prices displayed on Mobile Station include GST (default 18% across phones, computers, audio, and chargers). Eligible businesses can enter a 15-digit GSTIN to claim full Input Tax Credit.
documents.content_markdown:
## Tax Breakdown & B2B Input Tax Credit

Mobile Station generates compliant B2C and B2B tax invoices with exact CGST / SGST / IGST breakdowns:

- **Intra-State Bihar Orders** (`842001` / `842002` hub dispatch): Automatic **9% CGST + 9% SGST** split.
- **Inter-State Pan-India Deliveries**: Automatic **18% IGST** split.
- **Private PDF Archive**: Generated GST Tax Invoice PDFs are stored privately in encrypted S3/R2 storage and accessible strictly via time-limited signed links.
- **Seller-Controlled GST Eligibility**: Each catalog item explicitly indicates whether B2B GSTIN input credit is enabled.

| Electronics Category | Standard HSN | Default GST Rate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 5G Smartphones | `8517` | 18% GST |
| Laptops, Tablets & Monitors | `8471` / `8528` | 18% GST |
| Audio & TWS Earbuds | `8518` | 18% GST |
| GaN Fast Chargers & Power Banks | `8504` / `8507` | 18% GST |

documents.title: Returns, Refunds & Cancellation Policy
documents.summary: Clear return windows, sealed-accessory return eligibility, DOA inspection requirements, and refund timelines for prepaid UPI/card and pickup orders.
documents.content_markdown:
## Return & Replacement Windows

- **Phones, Tablets & Laptops (`7 Days`)**: Eligible strictly for **Transit Defect / Missing Item** refused at Open-Box Delivery, wrong model shipped, or OEM-certified **DOA** defect with a brand service center job sheet.
- **Peripherals, Chargers & Sealed Accessories (`7–10 Days`)**: Must remain unused with intact serial barcode, manuals, and retail packaging.

## Non-Returnable Scenarios

- Change-of-mind returns once an OEM smartphone/laptop retail seal has been opened and activated.
- Physical damage, liquid ingress, bent pins, or tampered IMEI stickers caused after customer handover.

## Refund Settlement Timelines

1. **Razorpay UPI / Wallets**: **2–4 business days** after hub inspection.
2. **Debit / Credit Cards & EMI**: **5–7 business days** depending on card issuer settlement cycle.
3. **In-Store Hub Returns**: Instant replacement verification or same-day UPI reversal at Motijheel (`842001`) & Club Road (`842002`).
